name: Banner of the Fallen

angles.text: Mountaineer Ylva died defending the honor of Ironforge and searching for missing kin. Recovering her trampled banner and avenging her death strikes at the heart of dwarven pride and duty.
The standard of Ironforge represents dwarven allegiance and defiance in trogg territory. Securing it honors the fallen soldiers who hold the line for the Alliance.

faq.answer: The fallen dwarf is Mountaineer Ylva, an independent-minded soldier who ventured into trogg country to search for fellow mountaineers who never returned from patrol. Armed with an Ironforge standard, she sought to prove dwarven resolve against the troggs before being struck down.

aliases: what is banner of the fallen
what happens in banner of the fallen
faq.answer: Banner of the Fallen involves discovering the body of Mountaineer Ylva and the trampled standard of Ironforge she carried. By raising the standard once more, an adventurer lures out her killer, the trogg Headsplitter, to avenge her death before returning the banner to Captain Rugelfuss.
faq.q: What is the quest Banner of the Fallen about?

faq.answer: Ylva was killed by a trogg known as Headsplitter, likely using a heavy spiked club that delivered a fatal blow to her skull and knocked off her helm. Raising the Ironforge standard provokes the creature to return.

aliases: where do i turn in the banner
faq.answer: Captain Rugelfuss is the dwarven officer overseeing mountaineer operations who receives the recovered banner. He recognizes Ylva's bravery and fierce independence, promising to clean and display the standard in her honor.

aliases: why did ylva go into trogg territory
faq.answer: Ylva set out on her own to investigate the disappearance of several mountaineers who had failed to return from a patrol through trogg country. Known for being fiercely independent, she carried the banner to demonstrate that Ironforge would never bow to troggs.
faq.q: Why did Mountaineer Ylva go into trogg territory alone?

faq.answer: Headsplitter remembers the Ironforge standard from striking down Mountaineer Ylva. Planting and raising the trampled banner once again provokes the trogg into returning to finish what it started.
faq.q: How is the trogg Headsplitter lured out?

sections.body: A trampled standard of Ironforge marks the site where an Alliance scout met a brutal end. Mountaineer Ylva ventured into trogg-infested territory determined to locate comrades who had vanished on patrol, carrying the city's banner as a statement of defiance. Her resolve was cut short when a powerful trogg struck her with enough force to shatter her defenses, leaving the proud standard cast down in the dirt.
sections.title: The Trampled Standard

sections.body: The trogg responsible, a brute known as Headsplitter, recognized the standard and the threat it posed. Raising the fallen banner acts as an open challenge, drawing the monster back into the open to defend its kill. Putting down Headsplitter allows the battered standard to be returned to Captain Rugelfuss, who sees to it that Ylva's weapon is passed on and the banner cleaned and preserved as a monument to dwarven tenacity.
sections.title: Vengeance for Ylva

summary: Banner of the Fallen tells the grim story of Mountaineer Ylva, a brave dwarf who ventured into trogg territory to track down missing comrades. After falling in battle and having her Ironforge standard trampled, raising the banner once more draws out her killer to face justice.
attribution: In-game quest text: Banner of the Fallen
